verdict.rationale: Lovable exposes an MCP server that lets external AI agents create projects, send messages, inspect code, and deploy programmatically, and a 'Build with URL' API for pre-filled prompts, which could enable some automated/programmatic triggering — but there is no documentation of a CLI, headless run mode, or CI/pipeline integration for automated builds. missing for 10: CLI/headless execution mode, explicit CI pipeline support, documentation of non-interactive automated runs.
